# MiddleClickAction

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** MiddleClickAction

## What it does

MiddleClickAction lets you bind useful actions to your middle mouse button (the default "pick block" key). Instead of the usual pick-block behaviour, pressing middle click will trigger one of two configurable actions depending on the selected mode.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/misc/middleclickaction). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
